data.name: Sea Hotel : Fish Scales
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Sea Hotel: Fish Scales!

Your mission: Fish, process your catch, satisfy the oceanic "visitors" that swim to your vessel, and upgrade your gear to unlock new waters! Customize your ship and captain with diverse skins to showcase your unique style.

Set sail for distinct seas:

  • Starting Waters: Begin your journey in lightless depths. Use ship lights to catch eerie glowing fish and uncover secrets veiled in darkness.

  • Carp Leaps Through Dragon Gate: Navigate waters inspired by China’s "Gaokao" tradition. Encounter customers like Koi, Phoenixes, and Chinese Dragons amid ancient Eastern aesthetics. (Purely thematic)

  • Da Huang: Explore mythic seas drawn from the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing). Discover legendary fish and witness the majesty of primordial beasts.

Master Your Gear:

  • Upgrade Knives: Handle bigger catches.

  • Upgrade Fishing Line: Plumb deeper sea layers.

  • Strengthen Hooks: Deal more damage to land larger fish.

  • Reinforce Hook Material: Catch multiple fish per cast.

  • Increase Sinker Weight: Dive rapidly to target depths.

  • Upgrade Ship Lights: Illuminate dark waters to reveal hidden fish.

Personalize Your Vessel:

  • Ship Skins: Unlock hull designs to make your ship stand out on the waves.

  • Captain Skins: Equip outfits to express your captain’s flair.

Experience relaxing fishing in Sea Hotel: Fish Scales! Manage your floating ship home, explore specially themed seas, and customize your journey. Embark now on your deep-sea adventure!

data.short_description: Experience the laid‑back joy of fishing in **Sea Hotel: Fish Scales**! Run your very own floating houseboat, explore uniquely themed ocean zones, and fully customize both your vessel and your character. Climb aboard now and embark on a deep‑sea fishing adventure that’s as stylish as it is relaxing!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) / Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: ntel Core i3-2100 或 AMD 同等性能处理器 (约 2.0 GHz 双核)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 成显卡(如 Intel HD Graphics 3000)或支持 OpenGL 3.2 / DirectX 10 的独立显卡(显存 256 MB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 兼容 DirectSound 或 WASAPI 的设备
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 /Windows 11
  • Processor: ntel Core i5-2400 或 AMD 同等性能处理器 (约 3.0 GHz 四核)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 持 OpenGL 4.2 / DirectX 11的集成或独立显卡(显存 512 MB 或以上，如 Intel Iris Xe,AMD Radeon Vega 3, NVIDIA GeForce GT 730)
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 兼容 DirectSound 或 WASAPI 的设备
